question: Which native boundary requests local human turn completion, and what remains required for configurable automatic completion?

scope.boundary: Selected exact native windows and generated corroboration. Three incidental body prefixes exposed by two generated-envelope errors supplied no semantic claim. No complete input, callback, status-writer or turn-lifecycle census is asserted.

dependencies.use: Five-word command record, numeric dispatch cases, completion masks and separate routing target.
Current turn/year and conditional calendar advancement.
Conservative live availability and local/human classification, with its pointer and lifetime limits.
Conditional application-owner construction and frontend-root publication.

nativeCommandNames.mapper: 0x82CD5400 bounds unsigned input to 0..65 and indexes table 0x82CD5420.
nativeCommandNames.inputJoin: Dispatcher 0x82CDDF18 loads record +0 into r30; 0x82CDDF40 copies r30 to r3 before the mapper call at 0x82CDDF58. This joins names to the native command type, conditional on normal intervening ABI retention.
nativeCommandNames.criticalJoins: Type 50: cell 0x82CD54E8 -> 0x82CD5774 -> text 0x82156DA0. Type 54: cell 0x82CD54F8 -> 0x82CD57A4 -> text 0x82156DC8. Type 63: cell 0x82CD551C -> 0x82CD5810 -> text 0x82156E24.
nativeCommandNames.qualification: These are selected Xbox-native debug labels. A label does not prove actual human input, delivery, authority, runtime ordering, synchronization barriers or checksum coverage.

humanCompletionBoundary.gates: The selected player's bit must be present in 0x830EE7E4 and absent in 0x830EE7DC; the player must pass local-or-nonhuman classification; status 0x82FFE7C4 bit 0x2000 must be clear. The path sets the staged bit at 0x82D26A28 and resolves local identity again.
humanCompletionBoundary.localPublication: On the second local equality, 0x82D26A38 calls 0x82D038E8(0). The call at 0x82D26A5C requests ImDone (50) with retained selected player, args2/3=-1, arg4 from 0x82F7AD00 and separate target=-1. It then clears status bit 2, calls 0x82D07CE0 and returns 1. The other branch requests AIDone (52) through 0x82CD5848.
humanCompletionBoundary.observationSeam: 0x82D26A38 is the earliest selected point after the shared completion gates and second local equality. 0x82D26A5C exposes the final request arguments. A default-off observer must preserve the complete guest context and read current valid memory without mutation. These interior points are not callable functions.
humanCompletionBoundary.deliveryLimit: Staging, submission, receipt and completed processing are distinct. Neither the staged bit nor the owner's return proves a delivered request or a completed world round.

status40Candidate.consumer: 0x82D26970..0x82D269B0 tests status bit 0x40, selected-player/local equality and an unstaged player before joining the shared completion gates. With bit 0x40 clear, the selected path continues current-unit handling at 0x82D26ACC.
status40Candidate.writer: 0x82E2C2E0 retains its incoming receiver. After 0x82E2B960, it tests receiver word +4 bit 0x100; the admitted arm sets status bit 0x40 at 0x82E2C3A8. Its entry first writes through receiver +0x40 without a null guard. The current receiver, flag producer, invocation cadence and physical action are not bound; this is application state rather than an identified input-event parameter.
status40Candidate.receiverLimit: The method occupies +0x14 in application tables 0x82120D68 and 0x82121100. Derived constructor 0x82E294D0 ORs bit 1 into owner +4, preserving rather than creating bit 0x100. The interface gate at 0x8314F28C is a separate object and is not this receiver.
status40Candidate.helperLimit: The 24-instruction 0x82E2B960 replaces its incoming receiver with scene globals and has no direct receiver +4 store. Its opaque calls do not close aliases or callback writes. Expanding scene presentation descendants does not identify an input operation.
status40Candidate.activeCandidate: A full-function wrapper around 0x82D259E8 could provisionally request completion by temporarily setting previously-clear bit 0x40 under current playable, same-match, latched-local-human and once-per-round guards, rejecting status 0x14000. It must preserve the original function and native completion checks, own and restore only its temporary bit in the then-current status word on every supported exit, and observe admission before treating the request as consumed. Missing physical-button identity alone does not reject this deliberate request candidate.
status40Candidate.unresolvedSafety: The consumer bypasses the selected current-unit continuation. A timely native clear of bit 0x40 is not proved; the selected stores preserve it, while the initializer's whole-word clear is not per-request consumption. Temporary-bit ownership, nested/concurrent native writes, callbacks, exit restoration, ordinary processing and completed-round ordering require validation. This is not an accepted active hook.

rejectedIngresses.pendingWord: 0x8314F11C is initialized by 0x82D25170 and unconditionally cleared at 0x82D25CA8 even when a prefix request is skipped. Writing it does not provide human End Turn or reliable acceptance.
rejectedIngresses.earlyMask: The 0x14000 test at 0x82D25F84/88 covers BeginTurnAI-origin bit 0x4000 and GameOver-origin bit 0x10000. The latter is set by case 63 at 0x82CDEDF0/F4. Neither bit may be manufactured as a human request.
rejectedIngresses.directEndTurn: Submitting EndTurn (54) directly bypasses the earlier human and AI completion chain.
rejectedIngresses.uiAsset: The GFX_EndTurn.gfx constructor selects presentation method 0x82E05200 through table slot +0x14. Its inspected body provides no direct completion submission or pending-word write. An asset name does not identify an action.

idleRoundContract.setting: A nonnegative integer N controls completed world rounds of human inactivity; default 100, zero leaves native behavior unchanged. It is not wall-clock time or a calendar edit.
idleRoundContract.latch: Latch match generation, human identity and initial round once. Request at most once per admitted round; a frame counter or queued request is not completed work.
idleRoundContract.rearm: Require natural ImDone receipt, subsequent AI/completion processing and EndTurn processing, then completed BeginTurn processing and stable playable return of the same human in the next native round. Calendar 0x82D1EC44 increments only on its selected first-human arm and may precede later work; its write alone cannot complete the counter.
idleRoundContract.lifecycle: Pause on modal, unknown state, identity change, defeat, victory or menu transition. Invalidate stale state on load/new game unless an explicit persistence contract rebinds it; an equal round number is not match identity. Countdown persistence and multiplayer policy remain separate decisions.
idleRoundContract.qualification: This specifies required observation and adoption guards, not an observed ordering or a delivered configurable mod.

runtimeAcceptance.wrapperBaseline: Observe full owner entry/exit depth, live status and intervening writers, current lifecycle/player/round/interface gate, completion admission and subsequent native processing. Bind nested consumers and native ownership changes before a deliberate temporary-bit experiment.
runtimeAcceptance.firstProbe: Correlate a real human End Turn with current 0x82E2C2E0 receiver/vptr/+4/+0x40, status-bit publication, 0x82D26970 admission and ImDone request/receipt in one match/player/round. Reject this receiver route if the action does not take it.
runtimeAcceptance.activeProbe: Only after proving temporary-bit ownership and all-exit restoration, test N=0/1/100, duplicate/deferred entry, modal interruption, human/turn change, failed submission, save/load and terminal state. Require actual NPC progress and exact release of human control after N completed rounds.

currentEvidence.method: Serialized foreground read-only Ghidra queries; supported-image word and SHA-256 checks; bounded generated corroboration and independent PPC decoding.
currentEvidence.boundedSearches: The pending-word census returned one raw lis/D-form candidate. The status census returned 45 rows without truncation; radius-eight windows covered 44 unique store sites and 737 words. A same-source immediate-set discriminator found only the selected GameOver and bit-0x40 writers. The raw direct-call census found no call to 0x82E2C2E0; pointer placement supplied two candidate table cells and a separate .pdata row.
currentEvidence.qualification: Syntactic scans exclude equivalent constructions, retained bases and indexed/computed aliases. No-match and untruncated output do not prove complete absence. Ghidra truncates several function models; exact words corroborate the selected local claims, not universal effects or runtime safety.

guards: Observe interior seams with complete context preservation; do not call them as native entry points.
Do not inject startup pending state, AI/GameOver bits, or the downstream EndTurn command as a human completion shortcut.
Do not equate a scene/application object with the separate interface gate or retain guest pointers across lifecycle transitions.
Do not count frames, submissions or an early calendar increment as completed rounds.
A demonstrated native bit clear, different input receiver or different path may refine the candidate; actual admission, restoration and round processing are still required before active adoption.
conclusion: The guarded local-human ImDone producer and a context-preserving observation seam are bound. A temporary status-bit-0x40 request at the full owner entry is a conditional active candidate; bit ownership/restoration, nested consumers and completed-round ordering prevent a runtime-safe active-hook claim.
